implementation_summary: Preview link with no stored preview.html: 409 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST changed to 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST (request not valid for sharing). Pitch link with no finished result: 409 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST changed to 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND, matching audit-export.ts. Running version 409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING unchanged. Corrected the existing preview test assertion from 409 to 400. Added a test for a failed version with no result expecting 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND and no link created.
risks: Preview-missing case is a judgment call: 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST was chosen over 404 because the version and result exist and only the preview file is absent. Reviewer should confirm this against the intended contract.
Wizard share-api.ts maps ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING only; the 404 and 400 replies for the share create path will show the server message. Not verified in wizard, which is outside ownership.
handoff: Share create now returns 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST for a missing preview and 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND for a version without a finished result. Any client that branched on 409 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST for these cases must use the new status. No contract or types change.
